options.en: This year's profit was more higher than last year's.
options.bn: This year's profit was more higher than last year's.

options.en: This year's profit was higher than last year's.
options.bn: This year's profit was higher than last year's.

options.en: This year's profit was more high than last year's.
options.bn: This year's profit was more high than last year's.

options.en: This year's profit was highest than last year's.
options.bn: This year's profit was highest than last year's.

why.en: Never combine "more" with an "-er" ending — short adjectives only need the "-er" ending.
why.bn: "More"-এর সাথে "-er" ending কখনো একসাথে বসে না — short adjective-এ শুধু "-er" ending লাগে।

q.en: "Of the five countries, Brazil had ___ population."
q.bn: "Of the five countries, Brazil had ___ population."

options.en: the most large
options.bn: the most large

options.en: the larger
options.bn: the larger

options.en: the largest
options.bn: the largest

options.en: more largest
options.bn: more largest

why.en: "Large" is a short adjective — it takes "the ... -est" for the superlative, not "most".
why.bn: "Large" একটা short adjective — এর superlative হয় "the ... -est" দিয়ে, "most" দিয়ে না।

q.en: Fix: "She is more good at Maths than her brother."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "She is more good at Maths than her brother."

options.en: She is gooder at Maths than her brother.
options.bn: She is gooder at Maths than her brother.

options.en: She is better at Maths than her brother.
options.bn: She is better at Maths than her brother.

options.en: She is the best at Maths than her brother.
options.bn: She is the best at Maths than her brother.

options.en: She is more better at Maths than her brother.
options.bn: She is more better at Maths than her brother.

why.en: "Good" is irregular: good → better → best. It never becomes "more good" or "gooder".
why.bn: "Good" irregular: good → better → best। এটা কখনো "more good" বা "gooder" হয় না।

q.en: Which phrase shows a trend that keeps progressing over time, useful for describing a line graph?
q.bn: কোন phrase সময়ের সাথে continuously বদলে যাওয়া trend দেখায়, line graph বর্ণনার জন্য useful?

options.en: colder
options.bn: colder

options.en: the coldest
options.bn: the coldest

options.en: colder and colder
options.bn: colder and colder

options.en: cold
options.bn: cold

why.en: A repeated comparative joined by "and" (colder and colder) shows continuous, progressive change.
why.bn: "and" দিয়ে জোড়া repeated comparative (colder and colder) continuous, progressive change দেখায়।

options.en: Than 2015, sales were higher.
options.bn: Than 2015, sales were higher.

options.en: In 2015, sales were higher than in 2016.
options.bn: In 2015, sales were higher than in 2016.

options.en: Sales were higher than 2015 happened.
options.bn: Sales were higher than 2015 happened.

options.en: Than in 2016, sales in 2015 were higher.
options.bn: Than in 2016, sales in 2015 were higher.

why.en: "Than" introduces the second thing being compared — it doesn't mean "in" or start a time phrase on its own.
why.bn: "Than" compare-করা দ্বিতীয় বিষয়কে introduce করে — এটা "in"-এর মতো অর্থ বহন করে না বা নিজে থেকে time phrase শুরু করে না।
